$schema_note: Aggregate counts behind the claims on no-ads.html. Competitor apps are anonymised as App A-E: the finding is about how ad funding behaves, not about naming rivals.
population_cap: Apple returns recent reviews first and caps at roughly 10 pages per storefront per app. This is a recent-weighted retrievable sample, not a census.
counting_rule_ad_content: a review must match BOTH the advertising vocabulary above AND a specific objectionable-content term: /indecent|inappropriate|nudity|naked|immodest|obscene|gambling|music ad|half.?naked|women exposed/i
caveat: A keyword mention is evidence a review RAISES a topic, not proof it is the sole cause of the rating. Two of the five apps show almost no advertising complaints; the pattern is concentrated in the ad-funded ones.
